gen-gf-manuale-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera reads wide and open-faced, every curve unobstructed. Manuale does the gentle, pencil-soft thick-thin shift best, while Lexend Tera sticks to a single-weight line with its stepping-stone gaps.
gen-gf-manuale-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta lays out tall little letters with wide tracking, cut like ribbon. Lexend Zetta's flat, stencil-cut strokes make Manuale's soft pencil-like thick-thin shift stand out as the literary half.
gen-gf-manuale-gf-montserrat-alternates: Montserrat Alternates crowds its lowercase up toward the capital line. Beneath Manuale's pencil-soft literary headings, those uniform rounds give a firm floor, with no hairlines or swells to compete.
gen-gf-marcellus-sc-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code draws a wire-like monoline with distance between neighbors that is hard to ignore. Marcellus SC brings the dignity, its tall bodies and tame contrast softening that technical-pen precision.
gen-gf-marcellus-sc-gf-cascadia-mono: Crisp and tall: Marcellus SC leans on a barely tilted calligraphy nib. Cascadia Mono stands in thread-thick curves and pin-straight letters, so the two feel like a hand-lettered note beside a ruled grid.
gen-gf-marcellus-sc-gf-julius-sans-one: Julius Sans One sits in generous blank space, its lowercase nearly capital height and every curve left open-ended. Marcellus SC adds a lightly engraved modulation up top, while the single-depth cut below stays quiet.
gen-gf-marcellus-sc-gf-lexend-giga: Dignified up top, Marcellus SC meets flat linework below. Lexend Giga's generous tracking and swell-free sans-serif outlines leave the slight stroke contrast in Marcellus SC as the thing you notice.
gen-gf-marcellus-sc-gf-lexend-mega: Approachable, Lexend Mega looks drawn with a single nib, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. And Marcellus SC's restrained ink-trace contrast would look best larger, with the body a size down.
gen-gf-marcellus-sc-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta reads big and friendly, with rope-like strokes, wide-mouthed curves and a big x-height that fills the line. Marcellus SC supplies the subtle modulation; Lexend Peta supplies the sturdy, uniform bulk.
gen-gf-marcellus-sc-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera draws a plotter-pen line, spaced like stepping stones. Against it, Marcellus SC's stroke weights differ just enough to feel alive, and that living quality is what sets the pair apart.
